description: This file defines an ApprovalService class handling submission approvals with validation, security, and audit features. It manages approval workflows, electronic signatures, SoD checks, and evidence packaging within a backend API context.

classes.name: SignatureError
classes.description: Exception for electronic signature validation failures.

classes.name: InvalidStateError

classes.name: ApprovalService
